text:
Rhea: Tiny question for the room: if you could give yourself one tiny, silly superpower just for Monday mornings, what would it be? :sparkles:
Ben: Instant zipper-to-coffee transformation. Pull a zipper, get a fresh latte. Practical magic. :coffee:
Kofi: Ability to pause time for 10 minutes to finish one sentence in a meeting. Very targeted. :stopwatch:
Maya: My power would be 'Inbox Teleport' 1 push, all low-priority threads get sent to a parallel universe.
Sana: Perfect hair that survives headphones and wind. Ask me why this matters later. :haircut:
Rhea: Love these. Bonus: name your villain (the thing that ruins your Monday despite powers).
Ben: Villain = The Unexpected All-Hands. Defeats coffee.
Kofi: Villain = The Phantom Calendar Invite (no agenda, lots of guilt).
Maya: Villain = The 2PM Slump. Sneaks in like a fog.
coffee-bot: Coffee delivery reminder: Monday Espresso Shots available in kitchen at 09:15. React :thumbsup: to confirm pickup.
Sana: I will take extra credit if someone codes a Slack shortcut for "summon espresso".
Ben: If Rhea's power exists, I'll trade my comic-book collection for a one-week trial.
Rhea: Vote with emoji: :one: zipper-latte :two: pause-time :three: inbox-teleport :four: perfect-hair
Kofi: :two:
Maya: :three:
Sana: :four:
Ben: :one:
Rhea: Results locked. Prize: moral support and a custom Monday meme from me. Post your villain captions and I'll illustrator-ify one. :art:
